name: copilot-token-efficiency-optimizer
description: Analyze a repo and apply token-reduction levers for Copilot agent mode (exclusions, scoped instructions, lean tool sets, plan/implement agents, healthy indexing) for more accuracy at lower AI-credit cost.

commands.title: Token Optimizer: Undo Last Applied Changes

tokenmin.exclusionAggressiveness.markdownDescription: How aggressively to recommend `search.exclude` / `files.exclude` globs. `conservative` excludes only well-known generated/dependency dirs; `aggressive` also excludes lockfiles, logs, and large data files.

tokenmin.modelFamilyPreference.markdownDescription: Preferred Copilot model family for the optional model-assisted tailoring pass (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `gpt-4.1`, `o1`). Falls back to any available model if the preferred family is unavailable.

tokenmin.applyToNewBranch.markdownDescription: When applying changes, offer to first create and switch to a new git branch so changes are isolated.

tokenmin.maxFilesScanned.markdownDescription: Safety cap on the number of files walked during analysis. Large repos are bounded to keep analysis fast.

walkthroughs.title: Optimize your repo for Copilot agent mode
walkthroughs.description: Analyze your repository and apply token-efficiency levers so Copilot agent mode works more accurately at lower cost.

steps.title: Analyze & Optimize
steps.description:
Run the guided flow: analyze your repo, review recommendations, preview diffs, and apply.
[Analyze & Optimize Repo](command:tokenmin.analyzeAndOptimize)

steps.title: Review the efficiency scorecard
steps.description:
Open the before/after efficiency report with deep links to indexing, debug logs, and cost controls.
[Show Efficiency Report](command:tokenmin.showReport)

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run package && npm run verify:bundle
